config.clean-hitbox.title: Clean Hitbox Config
config.clean-hitbox.tooltip.showBounding: Toggles the main entity bounding box.
config.clean-hitbox.tooltip.showEyeHeigh: Toggles the horizontal line at eye level.
config.clean-hitbox.tooltip.showLookVect: Toggles the line showing the entity's look direction.
config.clean-hitbox.tooltip.boundingBoxC: The default color for the entity's bounding box.
config.clean-hitbox.tooltip.eyeHeightCol: The color for the eye height line.
config.clean-hitbox.tooltip.lookVectorCo: The color for the look direction vector.
config.clean-hitbox.tooltip.targetHighli: The color the hitbox turns when you are looking at an entity.
config.clean-hitbox.tooltip.lineWidth: Adjusts the thickness of the hitbox lines (Vanilla is 1.0).
